"Create a massive, modern luxury supermarket in Roblox Retail Tycoon 2. Design a premium store with a stylish glass entrance, organized product shelves, grocery section, electronics department, clothing section, a large warehouse, multiple checkout counters, employee rooms, and a spacious parking lot. Use a black-and-white theme with golden accents, bright LED lighting, realistic decorations, and an efficient customer flow. Make the store highly profitable, easy to manage, and visually impressive. Include a large signboard with the store name “BREWORA MART”.
